justification: I inspected the exact-package sources with `rg -n "^package com\.google\.zxing\.maxicode;"` and found only one production class in the target package: `core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/maxicode/MaxiCodeReader.java` (116 lines). That class is a thin reader that only extracts pure bits and delegates decoding to `com.google.zxing.maxicode.decoder.Decoder`; the heavier logic is split into the decoder subpackage (`BitMatrixParser.java`, `Decoder.java`, `DecodedBitStreamParser.java`, 423 lines total), so the target package itself is not a concentrated, oversized God Component.
